title: InboxCounts
description: `GET /api/v1/agent-harness/inbox/count` and the `inboxCount` socket event (G2): unread notices, asks waiting on the person, and the badge (asks always, notices unless paused). A push may carry `recount`.

pausedUntil.description: Epoch ms the pause ends; null when not paused or paused until resumed.

working.description: The person's jobs at work (CJ14-FU-1): child runs in the `working` state that have started, the Jobs page's Working section (`vectors/working-jobs.json`). For the sidebar's Jobs entry. Absent: this server does not count them, and a client shows no count.

recount.description: A push only (FIXMS1-FU-1): a source that answers only with the person's own credential (their skill proposals) was not counted; the client fetches `GET /inbox/count` with its own session. Absent or false: the counts are whole.
